title: Bishop slides
summary: The bishop slides on diagonals and always stays on its colour.

steps.md: This is the **bishop**. It has a pointy hat. It slides on **diagonals**.
Corner to corner, like a slide!

steps.prompt: Slide the bishop to the star!
steps.hint: Go up and to the right.

steps.prompt: Slide the bishop to the star!
steps.explain: Up and to the left. Well done!
steps.hint: Go up and to the left.

steps.md: One bishop walks on **dark** squares. The other walks on **light** squares. Forever!

steps.question: Can a bishop on a dark square ever reach a light square?
steps.explain: Never! A bishop keeps its colour all game.
